feature: CS-05 — repo opt-out: spell_scope, a repository takes its spells from the user tier (Codex Support program)
assignedAgent: claude (role: Backend/Full-stack — no roster installed in this repository)
previousEpics: CS-03 stories in commit 8d32d3a / PR #232; CS-04 stories in PR #234

stories.title: The field, its validation, and the scope-aware component view
stories.description: Add spell_scope?: InstallScope to ArcaneManifest in src/types.ts (absent = repo) and validate it in src/modules/manifest.ts exactly as scope is validated; add componentForSpellScope(component, spellScope) to src/modules/user-tier.ts — identity for repo, files: [] for a spells-* component under user, every other component untouched (architecture D1, D2).
acceptanceCriteria: readManifest accepts spell_scope absent, "repo" and "user", and rejects any other value with ManifestInvalidFieldError
componentForSpellScope(c, "repo") returns the same object; under "user" every spells-* component has files: [] and no other component changes
A test pins that the set of components carrying a canonical or client-shim path is exactly SPELL_COMPONENT_NAMES, so a future client cannot drift past this design
npm run typecheck and eslint pass

stories.title: spell init: ask only when a user tier exists, default No, install no spell files when opted in
stories.description: In src/commands/init.ts add Step 5f — interactive-only, and only when readManifest(userTierRoot()) succeeds — asking whether this repository should take its spells from the tier, defaulting to No; resolve the profile's components through componentForSpellScope before the copy loop; record spell_scope in the manifest; adjust the preview/summary counts so an opted-in install does not claim spells it did not write (architecture D4).
acceptanceCriteria: With a store in the stubbed home and the question answered yes: zero files under .arcane/spells, .github/prompts, .claude/commands and .agents/skills; governance and instructions still installed; manifest records spell_scope: "user"
Answering no (the default) installs exactly what it installs today and records spell_scope: "repo"
No store in the home => the question is never asked and the manifest has no spell_scope
A scripted --profile install never asks and never opts in
The printed summary does not report spells for an opted-in install

stories.title: spell update: honor the opt-out and explain the orphans it creates
stories.description: In src/commands/update.ts resolve each component through componentForSpellScope in the repo scope, so an opted-in repository installs no spell files; extend the existing orphan summary with one sentence naming the opt-out as the reason when it applies. No new prune logic — resolveOrphan already reports always and deletes only under --prune while the recorded hash holds (architecture D3).
acceptanceCriteria: A repository that opts in after install reports every previously-installed spell file as orphaned and deletes none
With --prune the hash-matched spell files are removed and an operator-edited one is kept and named
The orphan summary names the opt-out as the reason when spell_scope is "user"
--dry-run writes nothing; a repository that has not opted in behaves exactly as before (existing update tests unchanged)
Switching back to "repo" and running spell update reinstalls every spell file

stories.title: spell doctor checkSpellScope (blocking) and the status scope line
stories.description: Add checkSpellScope to src/commands/doctor.ts and its check list: non-blocking pass when the repository has not opted in; when it has, a blocking FAIL if the store is missing or unreadable, a non-blocking warn on major.minor skew, and a pass that names the store, the spell count and a named probe (spell-status) when compatible. In src/commands/status.ts print Scope: repo (spells: user tier) when opted in, and say so when the store is absent (architecture D6, D7).
acceptanceCriteria: Not opted in => non-blocking pass, doctor's exit code unchanged
Opted in with a compatible store => pass naming the store path, the spell count and the probed spell
Opted in with no store => passed false and blocking (not blocking: false), message names `spell init --user`
Opted in with a store at a different major.minor => warn, non-blocking, names `spell update --user`
status prints Scope: repo (spells: user tier) when opted in and flags a missing store
Existing doctor and status suites pass unchanged

stories.title: Live two-repository check, docs, 1.2.0, bookkeeping, PR
stories.description: EV-01 with the built CLI: two repositories beside one user tier, one opted in and one not, confirming the opted-in one installs zero spell files, the other is unaffected, and doctor fails loudly once the store is removed. README's Once per machine subsection gains the repository half; CHANGELOG ## [1.2.0]; portable-bootstrap.md clause (source + parity copy); ARC-045 implementation note for decision 4; npm version minor as its own commit; PLAN.md CS-05 ticked with its Report line; PRD AC6/AC7 ticked; show-report regenerated in its own report-only commit; PR opened and self-merged under the codex-support-plan delegation once the three required checks are green (architecture D9).
acceptanceCriteria: The live check is recorded with its real output in docs/research/skill-discovery-smoke-tests.md
npm run check:version-bump passes (1.2.0 differs from main) and every gate in the architecture's Testing strategy is green
PLAN.md, PRD.md, DECISIONS.md, CHANGELOG.md and the show-report golden pair are consistent at HEAD
PR merged by rebase under the delegation; branch deleted after a content-verified check
